title: Carrier-preserving simplification and discoverable authoring
summary: Native KaTeX compositor conformance v2 completed all 27 slices and explicitly returned execution to carrier promotion. Resume at cps22 with the approved carrier semantics and choreography preserved.

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 27-slice proposal with two mandatory human visual checkpoints, preservation and rollback boundaries, discovery API requirements, verification cadence, and explicit deferrals.

revisitWhen: run-contract.kp.native-katex-compositor-conformance-v2 completes ncc27 and explicitly reactivates this return target
allowedWork: Carrier-preserving simplification semantic evidence, typed family and handoff contracts, renderer-neutral recipe, Native KaTeX exemplar, existing add-zero pressure caller, catalogue hosting, focused verification, discoverability metadata and APIs, governed authoring, mixed benchmark, and durable project records.

Reuse the existing deterministic clock, Native KaTeX endpoint handles, equivalent-pose seams, presentation registry, Catalogue host, URL state, Review lifecycle, and generated capability infrastructure.
disallowedWork: Fraction arithmetic choreography, other evaluation presentation families, matrices, code, Graph2D, Graph3D, learner layouts, curriculum, SRS, tutoring, Public Web, public authoring, universal renderer rewrites, caller-authored geometry or timing, and unrelated dirty work.
No promotion before both mandatory human checkpoints; no semantic identity inference from glyph equality; no silent generic fallback; no new clock, renderer branch, or model-authored authority.
goal: Prove carrier-preserving simplification on a canonical identity operation, pressure it on the existing add-zero caller, promote only the demonstrated boundary, and expose one discoverable human and LLM authoring API.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; stop at slices 15 and 21 for explicit human visual approval and never stage protected economics files or unrelated documents.
stopConditions: Stop at slice 15 for explicit human visual approval of the canonical two-times-one exemplar.
Stop at slice 21 for explicit human visual approval of the structurally different add-zero caller.
Stop if carrier identity would be inferred from glyph text or native geometry.
Stop if a caller requires timing, coordinates, opacity schedules, renderer nodes, another clock, or a caller-specific renderer branch.
Stop if approved contributor-fusion behavior, existing add-zero truth or IDs, static output, or direct URLs would change.
Stop if work expands into another family, fraction arithmetic, layout, cross-domain generation, or unrelated dirty files.
Stop on any unclassified verification failure or if deterministic seek, rewind, interruption, settlement, or ownership parity fails.

slices.title: Add-discoverability-metadata
slices.summary: Added canonical derived discoverability metadata for every equation-series declaration: friendly names, normalized aliases, meanings, positive and negative examples, required evidence, and support state. A single generated catalog rejects alias ambiguity and stale output; the carrier pair has concrete examples and counterexamples. Focused 23-test planner/registry cohort, generated-output check, and TypeScript pass.

slices.title: Expose-tool-neutral-discovery-api
slices.summary: Added a framework-neutral discovery API over generated plain data: list/search, inspect, friendly alias normalization, and deterministic ordered-LaTeX candidate narrowing. Data-driven rules cover both carrier identities and the contributor-fusion product contrast; no-match and invalid inputs stay typed, carrier lineage is never inferred, and custom rules extend without core switches. Eight focused tests, architecture gates, and TypeScript pass.

slices.title: Project-human-discovery-surfaces
slices.summary: Projected the generated API into a compact Coverage search/details surface and a three-line CLI with inspect/search output. Results expose meaning, positive/negative examples, evidence, and copyable commands; no buttons, ontology tree, or duplicated status authority were added. Unit, Svelte typecheck, accessible Chromium interaction, and bundle boundary pass (131,192-byte measured catalogue-route gzip under 190,000).
